ThingDef.label: cinnabar amulet
ThingDef.description: Scarlet is the colour of heat. Mercury holds one key to an ultimate dissolution. Contributes 4 Forge to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: malleus imperative
ThingDef.description: A tiny ear-bone, blackened by intense heat. Applied correctly, it can crack stone. Contributes 8 Forge to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: carcass spark
ThingDef.description: A remnant of a greater radiance, glowing softly as decay. Just possibly, a mote of the divided Sun. Contributes 12 Forge to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: meteoric bullet
ThingDef.description: Taenite-iron bullets are occasionally dug from the skeletons of unusual beasts. Someone has been hunting monsters. Contributes 4 Edge to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: Biedde's blade
ThingDef.description: A cut from this blade will not cease bleeding until the wound is healed. Contributes 8 Edge to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: furious sliver
ThingDef.description: When the Lionsmith turned against the Colonel, he crushed his own sword in his fist. Each tiniest fragment still thrills with rage. Contributes 12 Edge to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: stained gloves
ThingDef.description: What uses have these known? What lessons might they teach my hands? Contributes 4 Grail to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: hallowed polos
ThingDef.description: The ring-crown of a savage mother, stained with essence, woven with scraps of hair and blessed with flecks of skin. Contributes 8 Grail to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: chalice murmurous
ThingDef.description: On those nights when we drink from the chalice, we are not certain afterwards what we have done. Contributes 12 Grail to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: Marruvine idol
ThingDef.description: The Marruvii carved wooden idols to placate the witch-twins of their lake, shadowed with the aspect of the Heart. Contributes 4 Heart to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: wakeful tympanum
ThingDef.description: In the grove where they flayed the thunder, they rattled their instruments to rouse the frenzy. Contributes 8 Heart to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: kingskin bodhran
ThingDef.description: In the deep forests, the monarch gave up the last thing they had to give, shaping this drum to keep their land safe. Contributes 12 Heart to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: bone flute
ThingDef.description: Its sound will cease. Contributes 4 Winter to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: Elagabaline manacle
ThingDef.description: It does not relinquish its grip. Contributes 8 Winter to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: division bell
ThingDef.description: First, its voice, and after, nothing. Contributes 12 Winter to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: winged doll
ThingDef.description: In an attic above a skeleton house, wound in clotted hair, waited a doll because the window had never been opened. Contributes 4 Moth to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: dappled mask
ThingDef.description: Severed boughs let the moon and the blood dapple the rotting leaves on the forest floor. Contributes 8 Moth to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: Alakapurine shears
ThingDef.description: In a wealthy northern city, these shears were used to take from its silent protector first his hair, then his fingers, and then what remained. Contributes 12 Moth to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: icon of St Agnes
ThingDef.description: St Agnes of Bohemia was renowned for her pious dedication to the mortification of the flesh. Contributes 4 Knock to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: consecrated lintel
ThingDef.description: This is the skull of a door through which power has passed. Contributes 8 Knock to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: frangiclave
ThingDef.description: There are keys that open doors; then there are keys that destroy them. Contributes 12 Knock to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: paradoxical curio
ThingDef.description: An ormolu clock stolen in the sack of Vienna even as it rested safe in the vaults of Rome. Contributes 4 Secret Histories to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: atlas of dreams
ThingDef.description: One cannot map the Mansus, but one can make an attempt to map its reflections. Contributes 8 Secret Histories to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.

ThingDef.label: painting: Teresa and Christopher
ThingDef.description: Love, like the Mansus, defies boundaries. Contributes 12 Secret Histories to an altar vigil; stays intact after the rite.
